page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Continuation of a paragraph at the top (full width), then a centred heading block with a Greek line, then a verse dialogue with speaker labels in the left margin ("Tel.", "Fos.") and a catchword "Nunc" at the lower right.

main_text.p: mus, duce & auspice Christo Iesu Domino nostro; ut re ipsa experiamur, hunc omnipotentem, veracem Dei Filium in carne patefactum, in Spiritu iustificatum, nobis & in vita & in morte esse lucrum.
main_text.head: DIXI.
CARMINA FVNEBRIA. DE OBITV CLARISS. VIRI POETAE LAVDATISSIMI, Dn. FRIDERICI VVIDEBRAMI, S. THEOLOGIAE Doctoris, placidè in Christo defuncti Heidelbergæ: TELLVRIS ET FOSSORIS διαλογισμός.
main_text.p: Tel.CVr propriam fossor violas malefidè parentem, Rumpere cur huius claustra ligone paras? Nonne aliud fuerat, quo caca cadauera ponas Hospitium, an me non tristior extat humus? Antè salutiferas locus hic proferre solebat Herbas, nunc tetri plenus odoris erit. Antè puellaris flores hîc cura legendi: Tollere nunc erit hinc ossa retecta labor.

p.i: Quid doleas, nescis: fundis sine mente querelas: Nunc iras, grates, sat scio, deinde feres. Non mihi communis temerè pia membra parentis Rumpere, sed semper mens decorare fuit.

page.notes: The Greek heading word διαλογισμός is printed in the centred title block. The initial C of the first verse is a large woodcut-style initial. Speaker labels are printed in the left margin as "Tel." and "Fos." (the latter read as Fos.; it may be Fos. or Foss.).
